Nioh 3 Samurai Dual Swords Build - Flowing Flame
In this Nioh 3 build guide, we're going to be taking a look at how to put together the Flowing Flame build using the Dual Swords for the Samurai Style. This is an aggressive build, taking advantage of the high toughness of the Samurai style to deliver an onslaught of attacks while withstanding incoming blows. I'll be showing you where to place your stats and skills to get the maximum impact for this build, as which equipment to use, and which Guardian Spirits and Soul Cores to have.
This is an early an mid game build meant for players to put together from the early parts of nioh 3 and has the potential to keep on using it all the way to the end of the game.
